tasks.task: Write a Liquid or CSS snippet for one theme change

items.when: Before any change, so the owner sees what will change, approves it and knows how to undo it
When one small theme change must be built on a duplicate theme with clear install steps
When you need correct Liquid for products, carts or loops from pasted theme code
When the snippet is drafted, to catch repeated logic and common slips before the owner installs it
When you have the theme files locally and the change spans several files
When a change is growing and should be cut into small steps, tidy-ups kept apart from new behaviour

tasks.task: Build a custom section the owner can edit

items.when: Before building, to decide which sections and settings answer buyers' doubts
When the look is open, to get three on-brand designs and a build brief to choose from
When the section needs settings and blocks the owner can change in the theme editor
When you know the section and the theme and need installable code and what to upload
When the section is built, to check contrast, spacing, hierarchy and the phone view
Before publishing, to check the section's code for errors, speed and access problems

tasks.task: Show product details from metafields

items.when: When size charts, care notes, materials or prior prices must show on the storefront
When the field exists but must be set on many products at once
Before adding fields, to find ones that are unused, undocumented or share a key
When a theme without dynamic sources needs the field output written in Liquid

tasks.task: Review theme code before it is published

items.when: When someone edited theme files on a duplicate theme and you want a second check
When an AI tool wrote the code and it needs a pass for common AI mistakes
When the change has scripts or forms and needs a review for bugs and security gaps
When the change adds buttons, forms or pop-ups that keyboard and screen reader users must use

tasks.task: Make a theme change safely from request to publish

items.when: When the owner asks for a change to how the store looks or works
When the change needs a written request with scope, approval and undo steps
While coding, to change only what was asked and pick the simplest fix
Before publishing, to set the checks, the way back and how to know it worked

tasks.task: Check a store before it goes live

items.when: When a new store is about to go live or is moving platform or theme
When you walk the buyer path on a phone, then policies, prices, test orders and tracking
When fixes come in over days and each needs a re-check until a clear go or no-go
When you want the blockers scored and a test-order plan from the store's settings
When payment and checkout settings need their risks ranked before real orders arrive
When policy pages may be missing, clash with each other or read unclear

tasks.task: Get a store ready for a big sale or product drop

items.when: Two to four weeks before a big promotion, to plan the freeze, the timed changes and who does what
When a sale or drop is four or more weeks away and the checks need an order
When you need a speed budget, a test routine and a pre-sale checklist for the date
When heavy sliders, pop-ups and apps should be cut from the home and collection pages first
When a drop may draw bots or card testing and the store needs fraud rules ready
When the plan covers the happy path only and nobody has asked what happens when a step fails

tasks.task: Find why a store is slow and rank the fixes

items.when: When the store feels slow and fixes must be ranked by sales at risk against the work
When you have the PageSpeed report and need each page read and the field score
When there are many possible fixes and they need one order by payback
When the main image loads late and you need the code to make it load first
When scripts, styles and fonts block the page and must be delayed or deferred safely
When the page jumps as it loads and you need the shifting element and its fix
When you want the whole run in one go, with fixes priced in orders, to compare with your list

tasks.task: Run the monthly speed and app review

items.when: Once a month, and within a week of a new app, theme update or redesign
After uninstalling apps, or when old apps are suspected of slowing the store
When you have the theme files and want leftover app code found file by file
When each app needs a keep, remove or delay call from the speed report
When scripts and apps should be ranked by risk, not only by speed
Each month, to compare with last month and flag new app scripts

tasks.task: Plan the pages and setup for a new store

items.when: Before building or rebuilding, to agree which pages to build and what each must say
When the owner needs the plan, payments, domain and build order for their country
When the theme is not chosen, to compare a shortlist scored on the must-haves
When the page list needs a hierarchy, navigation and URL plan
When a first-time owner wants the whole path from plan to first order
When the page plan makes sense to the owner but a first-time visitor would have to think

tasks.task: Build or rebuild a product or landing page

items.when: When you have copy, colours and fonts and want three designs before any code
When the copy is approved and you need Shopify files with it loaded in and install steps
When the owner shows a page they like and wants their own version as Shopify files
When the page is built, to check it in a real browser at phone and desktop width
When it is a product page, to get ranked changes to variants, proof, buttons and price

tasks.task: Plan a move to Shopify from another platform

items.when: When the move has a fixed launch date and the checks must be set in order
When you need the data-move plan with field maps, checks and a way back
When pages and posts must move without losing search rank, links or bookmarks
When each old plug-in or feature needs a keep, swap or cut call on the new store
When the switch needs a staged rollout, a checklist and a rollback plan

tasks.task: Map and check product, customer and order files

items.when: When old export columns must be mapped to the new import format, with rules and gaps
Before import, to find blanks, duplicates and odd values in each file
When a file is messy and must be fixed and re-checked until it passes
After the product import, to find items that share a code or barcode

tasks.task: Build a redirect map from old to new URLs

items.when: When every old address needs a new home so search rank and links keep working
After redirects are loaded, to find ones that chain or share a target
When the new store makes several addresses for one page and search sees duplicates

tasks.task: Run launch day and the first-week checks

items.when: On the day, to walk the buyer path again on the live domain and place a real test order
Before the switch, to agree the checks, the way back and who decides
In the first weeks, if search visits fall after the move and the cause must be ranked
When a crawl of the new store is in and you need the few fixes that matter

tasks.task: Set up payments, shipping, tax and domain

items.when: When payment and checkout settings are in and need their risks ranked
When you need tax settings and rate rows for where and what the store sells
When the store needs zones, rates and a free-shipping line ready to enter
When the domain must point to the store with the right records and redirects

tasks.task: Set up selling in other countries

items.when: When you know the countries and gateway and need market groups, currencies and tax settings
When the owner has not chosen countries and needs them ranked with costs
When a new market is switched on and the buyer path must be walked in that country

tasks.task: Set up or repair store tracking

items.when: When Google purchase tracking must be built through the store and Tag Manager
When the Meta pixel misses or doubles sales and needs step-by-step fixes
When GA4 is installed and you need missing settings and store events listed

tasks.task: Fix technical SEO basics in the theme

items.when: When products, collections or pages have no search title or description
When the theme links to duplicate product addresses and each needs its fix
When product or shop pages need tested markup for rich results

tasks.task: Check and fix theme accessibility

items.when: When you need a page's access problems ranked before deciding what to fix
When you have the theme code and want the problems fixed and checked again
When the fixes are in a duplicate theme and need a last check before publishing

tasks.task: Write a script to read or change store data in bulk

items.when: When you need working queries to read or change store data, with paging and limits handled
Before any bulk change to live data, so the owner approves it and knows how to undo it
Before the script touches live data, to review it for bugs and unsafe handling of keys

always.when: On every code job, to change only what was asked and leave the rest of the theme alone
Before any code is handed to the owner, to catch common slips

helpers.when: When the job needs a custom app, a headless storefront or heavy JavaScript
When a migration risks search traffic and needs keyword and page-level checks
When the owner wants to know which page change will sell more, and to test it
When collections, filters, bundles or product data need planning before any build
When the store needs a full access audit and a statement, not a quick theme fix
When tracking is in place and the numbers need reading across ad platforms

gaps: No library item plans metafield and metaobject definitions or shows them on the storefront; only the kit skill covers it
No library item reviews Liquid theme code for Shopify's own pitfalls; only general code reviewers and the kit prompt
No library item plans a store move between platforms with step order, a freeze window and a first-week watch list
No library item maps product, customer and order files to Shopify's import format or checks an import report
No library item builds a redirect map from old to new addresses; the library only finds redirect chains afterwards
No library item writes a sale-day runbook with a freeze, timed changes and roles; only the kit prompt covers it
No library item edits Shopify notification emails or builds Shopify Flow automations
No library item covers checkout changes, discount logic or other custom store functions
No library item plans a theme update or a move to a new theme that keeps past custom changes
No library item sets up wholesale, point of sale or subscription selling in Shopify
No library item lists replacements for the features and apps of an old platform
No thinking lens in the library covers web speed
